data.text: Fostering boundless artistic expression, aesthetic sensibility, and cultural heritage through visual arts, Indian classical music, and theater.

items.title: Visual Arts Studio
items.description: Oil and acrylic painting, clay sculpting, sketching, digital illustration, and traditional Indian folk crafts.

items.title: Vocal & Instrumental Music
items.description: Classical vocal training, harmonium, tabla, guitar, synthesizers, and school choir performances.

items.title: Theater & Dance Studio
items.description: Classical Kathak, contemporary dance, elocution, street plays (Nukkad Natak), and annual stage musicals.
